blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: To save cost, practitioners often ask a language model to grade many independent items in one prompt. This assumes that verdicts are separable: that the verdict on an item does not depend on the other items in the prompt or on its position among them. Across three judgement tasks (harm in social-media comments, short-answer grading and review star ratings) and five open-weight models with 4-9B parameters, assigning the same 2,000 items to different random batches of 25 changes 11-22% of decisions on harm and grading, 6.5-13.3 points more than renaming the item keys or rewording the instruction, while AUROC against human labels differs from single-item grading only by -0.033 to +0.010; for four models with 14-32B parameters, 6-15% of decisions change, 4.2-9.1 points more. We show that flip rates decompose exactly into components of order, slot and membership, and that under a threshold model they grow with the square root of the variance that the context contributes, so that effects that are small for scores are large for decisions. Most of the latent dissimilarity between partitions comes from the order of the neighbours and the slot. The main effect of which items share the prompt, the part that voting over permutations of a batch cannot remove, accounts for 0.11-0.22 of it, and majority votes over nine permutations still leave 52-60% of the flips. Batched verdicts also differ systematically from single-item verdicts: even the majority of fifteen random batches disagrees with them on 8.4-17.8% of decisions. Editing a single generation shows that both the model's own earlier verdicts and the neighbours' texts carry the effect. On the easy task, star ratings, only 2.9-3.9% of decisions change. We recommend grading ambiguous items one per prompt, recovering most of the cost with a cached prefix, and reporting agreement with single-item grading whenever items are batched.
blocks.zh: 为了节省成本,从业者经常要求一个语言模型对许多独立项目进行一个快分. 这假定判决是可分开的:对某一物品的判决不取决于即时的其他物品或其在其中的立场。 在三项判断任务(危害社会媒体评论,短答分级和审查星等评分)和5个有4-9B参数的开放量级模型中,将相同的2000个项目分配给不同随机批量的25个变化中11-22%的伤害和分级决定,6.5-13.3分比重命名项目键或重写指令多出一分,而AUROC针对人类标签的单项分级只有-0.033分到+0.010分;对于4个具有14-32B参数的模型,6-15%的决定变更分多出4.2-9.1分. 我们显示翻转率完全分解成顺序,档次和会籍的成分,在一个阈值模型下,它们随着上下文所促成的差异的平方根而增长,因此对于分数来说较小的影响对于决策来说是很大的. 分区之间的潜在差异大多出自相邻者的顺序和槽. 其主要作用是分享快取,对一批的地表进行投票的部分不能去除,占了其中的0.11-0.22,超过9个地表的多数选票仍然留有52-60%的翻转. 批判判决也与单项判决有系统差异:即使是15个随机批判的多数对8.4%至17.8%的判决都不同意. 单代编辑显示,模型自身的更早判决和相邻的文本都带有效果. 在简单的任务上,明星收视率,只有2.9%至3.9%的决定有变化. 我们建议把模棱两可的项目逐一分级,用缓存前缀收回大部分费用,并在每批项目时报告单项分级协议。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Language models are now routinely used to label, grade and moderate text at scale. Because every request repeats the same instructions, a common way to cut cost is in-context batching : many items are placed in one prompt and the model returns one verdict per item, for example as a JSON object ( Cheng et al., 2023 ) . Vendors recommend it for moderation that need not happen in real time ( Anthropic, 2026a ) , and a recent study of social-science annotation finds batches of 25 to 100 items, with up to ten coded variables per prompt, safe for most current models: they save more than 80% of token costs and lose less than 2 points of accuracy ( Pipal et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 语言模型现在通常用于标注、分级和分级文本。 因为每个请求都重复同样的指令,所以削减成本的常用方式是内文分批:许多物品被放在一个快件中,模型返回每个物品一个判断,例如作为JSON对象(Cheng等,2023年). 销售商建议不需实时发生的节制(Anthropic, 2026a.),近期的社会科学注释研究发现分批25至100件,每件可快速最多有10个编码变量,对大多数当前模型来说是安全的:它们节省了超过80%的代币成本,损失的精度还不到2分(Pipal等,2026.

blocks.en: Batching rests on an assumption that is rarely stated: that the verdict for an item depends only on that item and not on its company (the other items in the prompt) or on its position among them. Nothing in a decoder-only model enforces this. When the model writes the verdict for the twelfth item, it has read the other 24 items and the eleven verdicts it has already written. Accuracy is also a poor test of the assumption, because shifts that push some items up and others down can leave aggregate scores almost unchanged.
blocks.zh: Batching是基于一种很少说明的假设:对某一物品的判决只取决于该物品,而不取决于其公司(即时的其他物品)或其在其中的立场。 只有解码器的模型中没有任何东西能执行这一点. 当模特儿写第十二项的判决时,它读了其他24项的判决和它已经写的11项判决. 准确性也是对假设的劣质测试,因为把一些项目推向上而把另一些项目推向下而使总分几乎保持不变的转变.

blocks.en: Figure 1: One short answer from SciEntsBank graded by the same model. The verdict is stable under trivial changes of the prompt (renamed keys, a reworded instruction) but changes with the batch; batches A, B and C differ in which 24 other answers share the prompt, in their order and in the slot of this answer. Each verdict is given with high confidence.
blocks.zh: 图 1:由同型号分级的SciEntsBank给出一个短答. 在提示的细微变化(重名密钥,重写指令)下判断是稳定的,但随批量变化;分批A,B和C不同,其他24个答案按照顺序和本响应的档位共享提示. 每个判决都充满信心。

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows what can happen. A correct student answer is graded correct when it is alone, partial in two random batches and correct in a third, each time with high confidence. Renaming the item keys or rewording the instruction does not change the verdict within a batch; changing the batch does.
blocks.zh: 图1显示可能发生的情况。 正确的学生回答单分时分级正确,部分分出两个随机分批,分出第三批,每分有很高的自信. 重命名项目密钥或重写指令不会改变批次内的判决;修改批次会改变.

blocks.en: We measure how often this happens, where it comes from and when it matters. We state the assumption formally as separability , show that the flip rate between random partitions decomposes exactly into components of order, slot and membership, and link flips to the variance of latent scores (§ 3 ). We grade the same 2,000 items per task alone, in three independent random partitions, and in conditions that each change a known subset of three aspects of the batch: the order of an item’s neighbours, the item’s slot, and which items are its neighbours. We compare every change against baselines measured in the same regime: renamed keys, a reworded instruction, and the same prompts generated one at a time. We then intervene inside single generations, editing either the model’s earlier verdicts or the neighbours’ texts, to see through which channel the batch acts. Three pass/fail criteria ( gates ), on generality, membership and mechanism, were fixed before the runs. Follow-up runs, not covered by the gates, repeat the core design on harm and grading with four 14–32B models and measure, for the five main models, what voting over permutations of a batch and over independent batches leaves (Appendix J ). Our findings:
blocks.zh: 我们衡量这种情况的发生频率、发生地点和时间。 我们正式将这个假设表述为可分离性, 显示随机分区之间的翻转率完全分解成顺序、位和会籍的组件, 单是每个任务,我们按三个独立的随机分区来划分2000件相同的物品,并且每个物品都改变这批物品的三个方面的已知子集:一个物品的邻居的顺序,物品的档位,以及哪些物品是它的邻居。 我们比较了每个变化和在同一系统中测量的基线:重新命名的密钥,一个重写指令,同一个提示一次生成一个. 然后,我们介入一代人,编辑模型的早先判决或邻居的文本,看看这些批发行为是如何发生的。 三个通过/失效标准(大门),即一般性、成员和机制,在运行前是固定的。 后续跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑 我们的调查结果:

blocks.en: • On harm and short-answer grading, a new random partition changes 11–22% of decisions for all five models, 6.5–13.3 points above the largest baseline, while AUROC differs from single-item grading only by − 0.033 -0.033 to + 0.010 +0.010 (§ 5.1 , § 5.2 ). For four models with 14–32B parameters, a new partition changes 6–15% of decisions, 4.2–9.1 points above the largest baseline (Appendix J ). • The order of the neighbours and the slot account for most of the latent dissimilarity between partitions. Which items share the batch accounts for 0.10–0.30 of it when the item keeps its slot (0.22–0.44 by the measure we fixed before the runs, which overweights the first slot). The main effect of membership, which voting over permutations ( Lin et al., 2024 ) cannot remove, accounts for 0.11–0.22 of the dissimilarity in runs that grade every batch in nine orders; there, majority votes over five and nine permutations leave 60–69% and 52–60% of the flips, and a threshold model fitted to these runs predicts the flip rates within one point (§ 5.3 , § 5.4 ). • Batching shifts verdicts and does not only scatter them: on harm and grading, a random batch disagrees with single-item grading on 10.9–19.8% of decisions, and the majority of fifteen independent random batches still disagrees on 8.4–17.8% (both on H200 NVL GPUs), close to what the threshold model fitted to the main experiment predicted, in a check that is only partly out of sample (§ 5.4 ). • Both channels act: swapping in another batch’s verdicts changes 7–23% of decisions, swapping in another batch’s texts 9–26% (§ 5.5 ). • The effect is large where the task is ambiguous. On star ratings, where models agree with the true rating at AUROC 0.96, the written rating changes for 16–21% of reviews but only 2.9–3.9% of decisions (§ 5.6 ).
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 在伤害和短答分级方面,新的随机分级对所有5种模式的决定变化了11-22%,高于最大基线6.5-13.3分,而AUROC则从单项分级只差-0.033-0.033至+0.010(§ 5.1,§ 5.2). 对于有14至32B参数的4个模型,一个新的分区变化为6至15%的决定,4.2至9.1分高于最大基线(附录J)。 邻国的顺序和时间档是分区之间潜在差异的主要原因。 当物品保持档位时,哪些物品共用批次占0.10-0.30(按照运行前我们确定的尺度,0.22-0.44),即超重的第一个档位)。 成员制的主要影响是不能取消的(Lin等人,2024年),在每批9次投票中,成员制占了0.11-0.22;在多数投票中,5和9次投票占60-69%和52-60%的倒数,而适合这些倒数的门槛模型预测了1分之内的倒数率(第5.3节,第5.4节)。 关于损害和分级,随机批次对10.9%至19.8%的决定对单项分级有异议,15个独立分批次的大多数对8.4至17.8%(均为H200 NVL GPU)仍然有异议,接近于预测的主要试验的阈值模型,只是抽样中的一部分(第5.4节)。 两种渠道行为:在另一批判决中互换改变7-23%的判决,在另一批判决中互换9-26%(第5.5节)。 在任务不明确的地方,效果是巨大的。 关于明星评分,其中模型与AUROC 0.96的真实评分一致,书面评分变化为16–21%的评分,但只有2.9–3.9%的决定(§ 5.6).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Placing several inputs in one prompt was proposed to save tokens and calls ( Cheng et al., 2023 ) . Follow-up work reports aggregate accuracy as the batch grows ( Larionov and Eger, 2025 ; Pipal et al., 2026 ; Fagerberg et al., 2026 ) , uses in-batch comparison for evaluation ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) or relevance ( Korikov et al., 2025 ) , and finds that accuracy depends on an item’s position; BatchPrompt votes over permutations to reduce this ( Lin et al., 2024 ) . These studies measure accuracy, not whether individual decisions change.
blocks.zh: 建议将若干投入放在一个提示中,以节省信使和电话(Cheng等人,2023年)。 后续工作报告,随着批次的增加,总的准确性(Larionov和Eger, 2025;Pipal等, 2026;Fagerberg等, 2026),利用批次中的比较来进行评估(Yuan等, 2024)或关联性(Korikov等, 2025), 发现准确性取决于某一项的位置; BatchPrompt votets over permutions来减少这种情况(Lin等, 2024)。 这些研究衡量的是准确性,而不是个别决定是否改变。

blocks.en: Closest to our work, Hida et al. (2026) report that 1–27% of screening decisions change between single-item processing and batches of 20, and that aggregate metrics do not always reflect these changes. Chen et al. (2024) place relevant or irrelevant documents before fixed targets and find contrast effects in relevance judgements. Huang et al. (2026) show that both the order and the composition of a reranking context change relevance labels, and Frohmann et al. (2026) show that batched scorers make different decisions under permutation at equal ranking quality and propose fine-tuning for order consistency. Related effects appear for harmful requests inside benign batches ( Kim et al., 2026 ) , for injected instructions that corrupt answers to other items ( Yue and Yao, 2025 ) , and for violent speech, which GPT-4 labels less often in larger batches ( Matter et al., 2024 ) . We add a decomposition that separates membership from order and slot, interventions that separate two channels within one generation, measurements of what voting over permutations (as in BatchPrompt) and over independent batches leaves, and a common decision-level comparison across tasks.
blocks.zh: 与我们的工作关系最密切的,平田等. (2026年)报告说,在筛选决定中,1-27%的决定在单一项目处理和20个批次之间有所变化,总的衡量尺度并不总是反映这些变化。 陈等. (2024) 将相关或无关文件放在固定目标之前,并在相关判断中发现对比效应. Huang等 (2026年)显示,重排上下文的顺序和组成都会改变相干性标签,而Frohmann等 (2026年)显示分批得分者在平分质量下会以等分排列方式作出不同决定,并提议为顺序一致性进行微调. 相关影响出现在良分批内(Kim等,2026年)的有害请求、注入的关于对其他物品腐败答案的指示(Yue和Yao,2025年),以及暴力言论,GPT-4在较大批次中贴出较少标签(Mater等,2024年)。 我们增加一个分解法,将成员与顺序和时间段分开,干预在一代人之内将两个渠道分开,测量对轮廓的投票(如在BatchPrompt)和对独立批次的投票结果,并进行不同任务的共同决策层比较。

blocks.en: LLM judges favour positions ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) , anchor on scores shown to them ( Kapetanovic et al., 2026 ) , drift with the polarity of earlier turns ( Temkit, 2026 ) and carry earlier decisions forward in sequential tasks ( Echterhoff et al., 2024 ) . Demonstrations bias predictions towards majority and recent labels ( Zhao et al., 2021 ) . People rate items relative to the range of items they see ( Parducci, 1965 ) and avoid streaks in sequences of decisions ( Chen et al., 2016 ) .
blocks.zh: LLM评委偏好职位(郑等,2023;王等,2024;史等,2025;以所显示的分数为主(Kapetanovic等,2026)),与更早转弯的极性相漂移(Temkit,2026)并按相继任务执行更早的决定(Echterhoff等,2024). 示威对多数和近期标签的预测偏差(赵等,2021. 人们根据所见物品的范围对物品进行评分(Parducci, 1965年),并避免裁决顺序的扭曲(Chen等, 2016年)。

blocks.en: Decisions that change with arbitrary choices raise fairness concerns ( Marx et al., 2020 ; Black et al., 2022 ; Cooper et al., 2024 ) ; in content moderation, Gomez et al. (2024) trace such arbitrariness to training randomness. Measurement frameworks for LLM judges split the uncertainty of their outputs into sources such as the judge model, the prompt wording and the sampling temperature ( Messing, 2026 ) , or fit many-facet Rasch models with rater and item facets ( Sachdeva and Boudol, 2026 ) ; batch composition is not among these sources. We treat the context of an item as the input of a variance decomposition ( Sobol’, 2001 ; Saltelli et al., 2010 ) .
blocks.zh: 以任意选择改变的决定引起公平关注(Marx等人,2020年;Black等人,2022年;Cooper等人,2024年;在内容上温和,Gomez等人(2024年)将这种任意性追溯到培训随机性。 LLM法官的测量框架将输出的不确定性分为诸如法官模型,即时措辞和采样温度(Messing, 2026年)等来源,或将多面的Rasch模型与测速器和物品方面相匹配(Sachdeva和Boudol, 2026年);批量组成不属于这些来源. 我们把某一项的上下文视为差异分解的输入(Sopol ' ,2001;Saltelli等,2010)。

blocks.en: Masks that let each item attend only to a shared prefix and to its own tokens were introduced for long contexts ( Ratner et al., 2023 ) , cached prompt modules ( Gim et al., 2024 ) , order-independent inputs ( McIlroy-Young et al., 2024 ) , position-invariant reranking ( Bito et al., 2026 ) and parallel decoding ( Glavas et al., 2026 ) ; in the first three, the text generated after the items attends to all of them. Serving systems reuse a cached prefix across requests ( Kwon et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) . We use them as the reference point: they make verdicts separable by construction if each verdict, too, is computed from the shared prefix and its own item alone, and if the key and the position ids of the item and its verdict do not depend on its slot.
blocks.zh: 允许每个物品只使用共享前缀和自有代号的面具被引入了长上下文(Ratner等,2023年),缓存了快取模块(Gim等,2024年),命令独立输入(McIlroy-Young等,2024年),位置不变量重排(Bito等,2026年)和并列解码(Glavas等,2026年);在前三回中,物品处理后生成的文本全部. 服务系统重复使用一个缓存的前缀,跨越请求(Kwon等,2023;Zheng等,2024). 我们用它们作为参考点:如果每个判决也是从共享前缀和单自项目中计算出来的,如果项目的关键和位置ID及其判决不取决于其时间档,那么它们就通过构建来作出可以分离的判决。

The model writes one JSON object with a level for every item, left to right, by greedy decoding. Flips therefore grow with the square root of the variance that a change of context contributes. At the median, a share of 1% of the latent variance flips 4.5% of the decisions and a share of 10% flips 14.4%. A change that is small on the scale of scores is large on the scale of decisions: when D D is small, averaging the scores over M M independent contexts, which divides the variance of the context by M M , divides the flips only by about M \sqrt{M} , and a majority vote over the M M decisions divides them by less (§ 5.4 ).

blocks.en: When the model writes the digit for the target in slot t t , its next-token distribution depends on the prompt and on the tokens it has generated, including its verdicts for slots 0 , … , t − 1 0,\dots,t-1 . We cut the generation just before the target’s digit, edit tokens, and read the distribution again; all other tokens of the answer, including its layout, stay those of the generation that is edited (except for one edit that lets the target be answered first, which keeps only the opening of the answer and gives its first key the target’s number). Editing the earlier verdicts while keeping the texts isolates the verdict channel of Equation ( 1 ); replacing the neighbours’ texts while keeping the verdicts isolates the text channel, at the layout of this answer (the texts can also change the layout that the model chooses, which the edit keeps). Since edited contexts are not generated, a decision here is 𝟏 [ ζ ≥ 0.5 ] \mathbf{1}[\zeta\geq 0.5] , where ζ = P ⁡ ( level ≥ τ ) \zeta=P(\text{level}\geq\tau) is read from the next-token distribution, renormalised over the levels, and every edit is compared with the unedited forward pass. If the channels add up, J = 0 J=0 ; if the four contexts are unrelated, 𝔼 ​ J 2 \mathbb{E}J^{2} is twice 𝔼 ​ Δ T 2 \mathbb{E}\Delta_{T}^{2} ; and if the channels add up on a latent scale that ζ \zeta increases with, a change of either channel cannot move ζ \zeta in opposite directions for the two values of the other channel (Proposition 11 , Appendix H ). blocks.zh: 4 实验设计

blocks.en: Harm : comments from the Measuring Hate Speech corpus ( Kennedy et al., 2020 ) with at least three annotators, graded on a five-level harm scale; the decision is level 2 (insults or harassment aimed at a person) or above, and the human label is the corpus’ hate-speech score above 0.5. Grading : student answers from SciEntsBank ( Dzikovska et al., 2013 ) , graded incorrect , partial or correct against a reference answer; the decision is correct . Stars : reviews from Yelp Review Full ( Zhang et al., 2015 ) , rated one to five stars; the decision is four stars or more. For each task we sample 2,000 items (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 伤害:来自"衡量仇恨言论书"(Kennedy等,2020年)的评论,至少有3名注释员,分级为五级;决定等级为二级(侮辱或骚扰针对个人)或以上,而人名标签是该书的仇恨言论得分高于0.5分. 分级:来自SciEntsBank的学生回答(Dzikovska等,2013年),分级不正确,部分或针对参考答案正确;决定正确. 星等:摘自"Yelp Review Full"(张等,2015年),被评为一至五等星;决定为四等星等或以上. 我们为每项任务抽样了2,000件物品(附录B)。

blocks.en: We use Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, Qwen3-8B with thinking disabled ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , Gemma-4-E4B-it ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) , Granite-3.3-8B-Instruct ( Granite Team, IBM, 2025 ) and GLM-4-9B-0414 ( Team GLM et al., 2024 ) , called Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, Gemma-4, Granite and GLM-4 in tables and text, in bf16 with greedy decoding, one RTX 5090 per model. blocks.en: Every item is graded alone and in three independent random partitions with k = 25 k=25 . For each partition we build the three derived conditions of Table 1 ; the fourth, a new random partition, is another of the three partitions. “Keep slot, reorder the others” holds five designated slots per batch. Baselines on partition 0: renamed keys ( m0 instead of c0 ), a reworded instruction, and the same prompts generated one at a time, which measures numerical noise from batched inference. Partition 0 is also cut into batches of 5, 10 and 50. Interventions use 200 targets per task, each placed in slot 12 and, separately, in slot 24 (the last) among 24 random neighbours; a second, independent set of neighbours supplies the swapped verdicts and texts.
blocks.zh: 每个项目单独分级,并分入三个独立的随机分区,以k=25k=25. 对于每个分区,我们构建表1的三个衍生条件;第四个,一个新的随机分区,是三个分区中的另一个. “保留档位,重新安排其他档位”,每批有五个指定档位。 分区0的基线:更名密钥(m0而不是c0),一个重写指令,同一提示一次生成一个,通过分批推论测量出数值噪声. 分区0也被切割成5,10和50分批. 干预措施使用每项任务的200个目标,每个目标放在12个档次中,24个随机邻国分别放在24个档次(最后一个档次);第二组独立的邻国提供互换的裁决和文本。

blocks.en: Intervals of flip rates, of the shares fixed before the runs and of the gates are percentile bootstraps over the batches of the base partition (300 resamples); they ignore the clustering of items in the batches of the second partition. The quantities of the formal framework from the main experiment (§ 5.3 , § 5.4 , Appendix I ) and from the larger models of Appendix J average over the three base partitions, which hold the same items; their intervals resample the items once for all three (1,000 resamples; 10,000 for the bound of Equation ( 4 )) and ignore that items share generated prompts; § 5.3 shows how much this matters. The intervals of the voting experiments of Appendix J instead treat the items as clustered in the batches of every partition. All intervals are pointwise. With Holm’s adjustment for the ten model–task pairs (two-sided tests at 5%, normal approximation with the bootstrap standard deviation), the main effect of membership differs significantly from zero in five pairs instead of six (for Gemma-4 on harm only narrowly, so that this count depends on the random draw of the bootstrap), the bound on the bias in six instead of eight, and the slot in nine, as without the adjustment. Before the runs we fixed three gates. G1 (generality): on each of the two tasks added to harm (grading and stars), for at least three of the five models, the flip rate between two new partitions exceeds the largest batched baseline, with a lower bound of the excess of 2 points or more; the excess is computed between partitions 0 and 1. G2 (membership): the membership share at a fixed slot on the latent scale (§ 3 ) has a lower bound above 0 on at least two tasks for at least three models. G3 (mechanism): the unedited intervention reproduces the generated verdict except where two levels are nearly tied, and at least one channel changes 3% of decisions or more. 2 2 2 G3 first required 99.5% reproduction. Smoke tests before the full runs (two targets per task, each in slots 12 and 24: 12 placements per model) showed that in bf16, generation with a key-value cache in a padded batch and a single forward pass can differ in probability, by up to 0.10 on near-ties; in the smoke outputs that were kept, those of Qwen3-4B and Gemma-4 (24 placements), one placement of Qwen3-4B also differs by 0.47 without being a near-tie. Before the full runs we therefore added the exception for near-ties, and we measure every edit against the unedited forward pass, which shares its numerical regime.

blocks.en: Table 2 gives the main result. On harm and grading, a new random partition changes 11–22% of decisions for each of the five main models. The largest baseline, renamed keys or a reworded instruction, changes 4.2–8.4% (numerical noise alone, from generating the prompts one at a time: 0.5–2.1%), and the lower bound of the excess is 5.3–11.1 points across the ten model–task pairs. On star ratings a new partition changes 2.9–3.9% of decisions, 1.4–2.0 points above the baselines, with lower bounds of 0.6–1.3 points. G1 as fixed before the runs is therefore met on grading (five of five models) but not on stars (none), so we claim generality only for judgements with real ambiguity; on harm, the task we started from, all five models exceed the same bar. So do the four larger models of Appendix J , run on harm and grading with the same partitions and baselines on H200 NVL GPUs: a new partition changes 5.9–14.6% of their decisions, 4.2–9.1 points above the largest baseline, with lower bounds of about 3 points or more.
blocks.zh: 表2提供了主要结果。 在伤害和分级方面,一个新的随机分区会改变五个主要模型中每个模型的11-22%的决定。 最大的基线,更名的密钥或重写指令,改变4.2-8.4%(仅数字噪音,一次产生一个提示:0.5-2.1%),超过的下限为5.3-11.1分,跨10个模型任务对. 在恒星评分上,新分区改变2.9–3.9%的决定,比基线高1.4–2.0分,下限为0.6–1.3分. 因此,在运行前固定的G1在分级(5个型号中的5个)而不是在恒星上(无),所以我们声称一般性只用于真正含糊不清的判断;在伤害上,我们开始的任务,所有5个型号都超过了同一个条. 因此,附录J的4个较大的模型也在H200 NVL GPU上运行并使用相同的分区和基线进行分级:新的分区改变5.9-14.6%的决定,4.2-9.1分高于最大基线,下限大约为3分或更多.

blocks.en: Looking at written levels rather than decisions, a new partition changes the level of 16–39% of items across all tasks, 1.6–2.9 times as often as rewording the instruction (Table 5 , Appendix C ). On stars, 76–83% of these changes are between neighbouring ratings on the same side of the threshold.
blocks.zh: 从书面层面来看,而不是从决定层面来看,新的分区会改变所有任务中16-39%的项目的水平,1.6-2.9倍于重写指令(表5,附录C ) 。 在恒星上,这些变化中76–83%是在同一面的相邻收视率之间.

blocks.en: 5.2 Accuracy understates it
blocks.zh: 5.2 准确度低报

blocks.zh: 表3:单独分级时和分批分出25个分级时与人类标签相对应的AUROC,以及决定阈值以上物品的比例(百分比,单独分出-至分批分出)。

blocks.en: AUROC of the written level against human labels changes by − 0.033 -0.033 to + 0.010 +0.010 (Table 3 ). For six of the ten model–task pairs, the change exceeds what resampling items would produce (paired item bootstrap), so accuracy does register batching, but a change of this size would pass most validation thresholds although 11–22% of the decisions differ between partitions. Rank agreement with the three-level human grades falls by up to 0.10 on grading. The operating point moves more: on harm, Gemma-4 and Granite flag far fewer comments in batches (Table 3 ), as do three of the four larger models of Appendix J (by 9–17 points), a shift that an accuracy check with a tuned threshold would also miss. On harm, accuracy even favours batching for the larger models: AUROC of the written level rises by 0.011–0.057 (clearly beyond resampling noise for three of them and only just for Qwen3-14B ), because when they grade the comments alone they put many of them on one level, whose ties lower AUROC (Table 16 ); on grading it changes by − - 0.021 to +0.035. A validation on labelled data would thus approve batching on harm although 8.4–14.6% of their harm decisions change between partitions. An earlier study of a partly overlapping sample of 2,000 random comments (258 in common with the main sample) with the same prompt (Appendix F ) gives the same picture: batching changed 13–21% of decisions for the five main models, against 0.9–3.2% for renamed keys. There, models also shift in different directions on the same comments: Gemma-4 flags 58% of the comments that target a race when it grades them alone and 35% in batches, while GLM-4 flags more of them in batches (Table 9 ; point estimates).
blocks.zh: AUROC针对人类标签的书面级别变化为-0.033-0.033至+0.010+0.010(表3)。 对于10个模型任务配对中的6个,变化超过了重新标注项目将产生的结果(被标注的项目靴子),因此,精确度是登记批量的,但这种大小的改变将超过大多数验证阈值,尽管11–22%的决定在分区之间有所不同。 与三级人大等级的分级协议在分级上最高为0.10分. 操作点移动得更快:在伤害上,Gemma-4和Granite旗在分批(表3)中的评论要少得多,附录J的4个较大模型中的3个(乘以9–17分)也是如此,这种带有调值阈值的精确检查也会错过. 在危害方面,精确度甚至倾向于对较大的模型进行分批:书面级的AUROC上升了0.011-0.57(明显超出了对其中3个,仅对Qune3-14B的再作取样),因为当它们单独对评论进行分级时,它们就把许多评论放在一个级别上,其关系低于AUROC(表16);在分级时,变化为−--0.021到+0.035。 因此,对标有标签的数据进行验证将批准对损害进行分批处理,尽管它们损害决定的8.4%-14.6%在分区之间有所改变。 先前对2000个随机评论的样本(258个与主样本相同)进行了部分重叠的研究,该样本与同一快取(Appendix F )给出了同样的情况:5个主要模型的批量改变了13-21%的决定,而重命名的密钥则改变了0.9-3.2%的决定. 在那里,模型在相同评论上也向不同方向转变:Gemma-4旗下58%的评语是针对单次评分的赛事,而GLM-4旗下则多为分次评分(表9;分点估计).

blocks.en: Two facts explain why accuracy is a poor test (Appendix H ). If e A e_{A} and e B e_{B} are the shares of decisions in two conditions that differ from the labels and e A ​ B e_{AB} the share on which both do, the flip rate between the conditions is e A + e B − 2 ​ e A ​ B e_{A}+e_{B}-2e_{AB} , the errors that they do not share (Proposition 9 ): with error rates of 20–38% at the decision threshold, equal accuracy is compatible with any flip rate from 0 to 41–74%. And under a threshold model, a context that carries a share of the variance of the scores within a class lowers AUROC, relative to the scores averaged over contexts, in proportion to this share (Proposition 10 ), but flips decisions in proportion to its square root (Proposition 3 ).

The order of the neighbours accounts for 0.42–0.69 of it, the slot for 0.09–0.32, the main effect of membership for 0.01–0.25 (mean 0.15) and the interaction of slot and membership for − - 0.07 to 0.18 (mean 0.07). blocks.en: The membership share at a fixed slot as we fixed it before the runs, ( D comp − D keep ) / D new (D_{\mathrm{comp}}-D_{\mathrm{keep}})/D_{\mathrm{new}} on the latent scale, is 0.22–0.44, and its lower bound is above 0 in every pair, so G2 is met as specified. This measure, however, gives the first slot a fifth of the weight and so overstates the effect of membership (§ 3 ). With the designated slots weighted as in a random partition, it is 0.10–0.30 (mean 0.22), and its lower bound is above 0 in four of the ten pairs and on both tasks for one of the five models, so G2 would not be met. This verdict depends on how the order component is estimated. Other items also keep their slot and their membership: those that keep their slot by chance in the reordered batch, which measure the order component exactly in expectation (Proposition 6 (iv)), and the other items of “keep slot, reorder the others” that land in their own slot, which give a lower bound like the designated ones. With both added, and the first, the last and the interior slots weighted 1 / 25 1/25 , 1 / 25 1/25 and 23 / 25 23/25 as in a random partition (evenly over the items of each group), the share is 0.12–0.35, its lower bound is above 0 in seven pairs and on both tasks for three models, and G2 would be met; adding only one of the two gives at most two models, a count that also depends on the random draw of the bootstrap. Once the first slot is weighted correctly, G2 is therefore borderline. On average, more of this share is the main effect of membership (mean 0.15) than the interaction of slot and membership (mean 0.07), but the interaction is at least as large in five of the ten pairs, and on the scale of decisions the two means are about equal (0.08 and 0.07). The main effect needs no designated slots, is positive in all ten pairs and excludes zero in six (in five with clustered prompts). The voting experiment of § 5.4 , which grades every batch of partitions 0 and 1 in nine orders, estimates it more precisely: 0.11–0.22 of D new D_{\mathrm{new}} (pooled 0.17), and its intervals, clustered by the batches of both partitions, exclude zero in all ten pairs (Appendix J ). Which neighbours an item has therefore matters, less than the measure fixed before the runs suggested, and partly in a way that a vote over permutations does not average out. Order and slot together account for the larger part, which is consistent with earlier findings on position ( Lin et al., 2024 ; Frohmann et al., 2026 ) . On stars, D new D_{\mathrm{new}} is only 0.005–0.008 (flip rates of 3–4%), too small to split into components with useful precision; we decompose only when D new ≥ 0.01 D_{\mathrm{new}}\geq 0.01 . We also leave out Gemma-4-31B of Appendix J ( D new D_{\mathrm{new}} of 0.018–0.030): its estimate of the interaction on grading violates Proposition 2 .

blocks.en: The threshold model behind the latent scale makes predictions for patterns of decisions to which it was not fitted (Proposition 7 in Appendix H , Table 11 ). On harm and grading, fitted to pairs of conditions, it predicts the share of items whose decisions in six batches, which we treat as independent, are not all equal (24.5–49.9% of the items) with a mean absolute error of 0.4 points, the flips between two majority votes over three batches each with a mean absolute error of 0.7 points, and the share of items for which two orders of one batch agree, two orders of another batch agree, and the two batches differ (2.5–5.2%) with a mean absolute error of 0.3 points. The errors of the first two have a direction: the model predicts too few items whose decisions are not all equal in nine of the ten pairs and too many flips between majority votes in seven, in three of them by more than two standard errors; averaged over the ten pairs, the first prediction is 0.3 points too low and the second 0.6 points too high. Without a main effect of membership, the prediction for the last pattern is below the observed share in ten of the ten pairs. Refitted to fifteen independent partitions (§ 5.4 ), the model shows the same two directions, and the first error, for the items whose decisions are not all equal, grows with the number of batches: pooled over the ten pairs, measured minus predicted is +0.2, +0.9 and +1.8 [+1.4, +2.2] points for five, nine and fifteen batches, and − - 0.4 [ − - 0.5, − - 0.3] points for the flips between two majorities over three batches. The model has limits: its dissimilarity depends on the threshold of the scale, by a factor of 1.4–2.8 between thresholds on harm and 3.2–5.2 on stars, where the primary threshold gives the smallest value for five of the five models (Table 15 ).
blocks.zh: 潜在比额表背后的阈值模型预测了没有适应的决定的模式(附录H中的建议7,表11)。 在损害和分级方面,它根据各种条件,预测了我们视六批决定为独立的项目所占的份额(24.5-49.9%),平均绝对误差为0.4分;两个多数票比三个批次翻转,平均绝对误差为0.7分;一个批次的两个顺序同意的项目所占的份额;另一个批次的两个顺序同意,两个批次不同(2.5-5.2%),平均绝对误差为0.3分。 前两作的错误有一个方向:模型预测,在十对中的九对中,其决定不完全相等的项目太少,在七分中多数票之间的翻转太多,其中三分中标准错误超过两个;在十对中平均,第一个预测的0.3分太低,第二个0.6分太高. 由于没有会员制的主要作用,对后一种模式的预测低于所观测到的十对中的十对比例. 折回到15个独立分区(§ 5.4),模型显示相同的两个方向,第一个错误,对于其决定不均匀的项目,随着批次数的增加而增加: 集合于十对以上,所测倒数为+0.2,+0.9和+1.8[+1.4,+2.2]分,分数为五批,九批和十五批;− 0.4 [−--0.5,−-0.3] 三批中两个多数之间的翻转点. 该模型有限度:它的不相干性取决于天平的阈值,在伤害阈值和恒星3.2-5.2之间的系数为1.4–2.8,其中主阈值给出了五种模型中的五个最小值(表15.

blocks.en: 5.4 What voting leaves
blocks.zh: 5.4 (中文(简体) ). 表决结果

blocks.en: Voting over permutations of a batch averages over order and slot, and with them over the interaction of slot and membership; it leaves the main effect of membership (Proposition 4 ). We ran it for the five models on H200 NVL GPUs: every batch of partitions 0 and 1 was graded in nine orders, the first being that of the main experiment (Appendix J , Table 17 ). Majority votes over three, five and nine permutations leave 71–76%, 60–69% and 52–60% of the flips between the two partitions (after nine, 56% [53, 58] pooled over the ten model–task pairs), at three, five and nine times the cost. Fitted to the same runs, the threshold model predicts the flip rates after three to nine permutations within one point in every pair, slightly too high on average (by 0.2–0.3 points pooled); as shares of the flips of single orders, its predictions differ from the measured ones by up to 6.1 points (Table 17 ). The predictions of Table 12 , made from the main experiment before these runs, are too high by 0.2 points on average after nine permutations, but per pair they miss by − - 2.0 to +2.2 points (predicted minus measured; as shares of the flips of single orders, by − - 10 to +11 points, Table 17 ), mainly because the main design estimates the main effect of membership imprecisely; the measured flips lie inside their intervals in eight of the ten pairs. A majority vote removes flips more slowly than the mean score of the same permutations would (Appendix H ), because it discards how far each score lies from the threshold: without a main effect of membership ( D resh D_{\mathrm{resh}} set to D new D_{\mathrm{new}} , which keeps the flips of single batches), five and nine permutations would still leave 54–58% and 42–45% of the flips, against 46–49% and 34–37% for the mean score, which approaches 1 / m 1/\sqrt{m} , 45% and 33%, as D → 0 D\to 0 . In the voting runs, averaging the level probabilities over nine orders leaves 49–60% of the flips that the same rule gives with single orders, since the main effect of membership remains. With more permutations the flips decrease towards a limit, which no odd number of permutations reaches (Proposition 4 ) and which the model fitted to the voting runs puts at 4.5–8.9% of the items.
blocks.zh: 表决一个批次的轮廓平均胜于顺序和时段,而与它们则胜于时段和成员之间的相互作用;它留下了成员的主要影响(建议4)。 我们在H200 NVL GPU上运行了5个型号:每批分区0和1分被分出9个顺序,第一个是主实验(Appendix J,表17. 多数选票超过三票、五票和九票,在两个分区之间留下了71-76%、60-69%和52-60%的翻转(9后,56%[53,58]在10个模式-任务对上集合),成本为3、5和9倍。 与同跑相适应的阈值模型预测每对一分内三至九分的翻转率,平均略高(0.2-0.3分集合);由于单次订单翻转的分数,其预测数与所测分数相差可达6.1分(表17. 从这些运行前的主要实验中得出的表12的预测值,在9个通量后平均过高了0.2分,但每对漏取了−-2.0至+2.2分(预计为减分;作为单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单单 多数选票取消翻转的速度比同一轮次的平均得分慢(附录H),因为它放弃了每一轮次得分离门槛有多远:没有会员制的主要效果(D resh D_{\mathrm{resh}}}被设定为D_{\mathrm{new}}},这保持了单批次的翻转),5和9轮次仍然会留下54–58%和42–45%的翻转,而平均得分的46–49 %和34–37 %,后者接近1/m 1/sq{rt{m},45%和33%,因为D→ 0 D\. 在投票中,平均9个命令的概率水平留有49-60%的倒数,因为会员制的主要效果依然存在。 随着更频繁的循环,翻转逐渐下降,达到极限,没有达到奇数的排列(建议4),而适合投票运行的模型则达到4.5-8.9%。

blocks.en: Voting over batches instead of permutations averages over the membership as well, but it converges to the main batched decision, not to the single-item decision (Proposition 5 ). On harm and grading, a random batch gives 11–20% of the items a decision that differs from the one they get alone. For 3.5–10.2% of the items all three partitions differ from it, so by Equation ( 4 ) the mean bias is at least 0.35–7.06%, without any model; the interval of this bound excludes zero in eight of the ten pairs. Under the threshold model the mean bias is 8–19% (Proposition 8 , Table 13 ). On stars the bias under the model, 3.8–5.2%, is larger than the share of decisions that change between two partitions (3.1–4.0%, mean of the three pairs) for four of the five models and about as large for Qwen3-8B (3.8% against 4.0%); without a model, the bound of Equation ( 4 ) on stars is 0.98–2.04%, and its interval excludes zero for five of the five models.
blocks.zh: 分批表决而不是分批表决也平均超过成员,但它与主要的分批决定一致,而不是与单一项目的决定一致(建议5)。 在伤害和分级方面,随机批量地给予11-20%的项目一个与它们单独得到的决定不同的决定。 对于3.5-10.2%的所有三个分区都与其不同,所以按照"方程式"(4),平均偏差至少为0.35-7.06 %,没有任何模型;这个约束的间隔排除了十对中的八对中的零. 根据门槛模型,平均偏差为8-19%(建议8,表13)。 在恒星上,模型下偏差为3.8-5.2 %,大于在五个模型中四个模型(3.1-4.0%,三对的平均值)和Qune3-8B(3.8%对4.0%)之间变化的决定比例;没有模型,等分法(4)在恒星上的界限为0.98-2.04%,其间隔排除了五个模型中的五个的0。

blocks.en: We measured what voting over batches leaves on harm and grading: partition 2 and twelve further random partitions, graded on the same type of GPU as the voting runs, give every item, together with partitions 0 and 1, fifteen independent batches (Appendix J , Table 18 ). Their majority still differs from the single-item decision for 8.4–17.8% of the items (pooled 12.6% [12.1, 13.2]), against 10.9–19.8% for one batch (pooled 16.0%), so fifteen batches remove only about a fifth of the disagreement. The threshold model fitted to the main experiment predicted the majority of fifteen batches with a mean absolute error of 0.6 points (at most 1.5). Since three of the fifteen partitions and the single items repeat the prompts it was fitted to, this check is only partly out of sample: on the twelve new partitions alone its error reaches 1.6 points, and the model-free majority of the nine batched decisions of Table 13 predicts the fifteen-batch majority about as well (mean absolute error 0.5 points). With the batched threshold chosen in every partition so that batches give as many positive decisions as single-item grading, the majority still differs for 7.9–13.5% of the items (pooled 10.4% [9.9, 10.9], 82% of the uncalibrated share); only for Gemma-4 and Granite on harm is about half of the disagreement a shift of the operating point. Batching is therefore not only noise around the single-item decision: most of the disagreement is specific to the item, and voting over batches does not remove it. Single-item grading, however, is no privileged context: after the calibration it differs from the majority of thirteen of the fifteen batches about as often as one batch differs from the majority of thirteen of the other fourteen (pooled 10.4% against 11.0%; per pair from 3.4 points less often, for Granite on grading, to 4.3 points more often, for Qwen3-8B on grading). Nor does disagreement mean error: on the items where the majority of fifteen batches and the single item differ, the majority matches the human label for more than half of them in four of the ten pairs (for up to 83%). The measured disagreement also depends on the single-item prompt: with the reworded single-item prompt of the RTX 5090 runs as the reference, it changes by − - 4.5 to +1.7 points per pair, although pooled only from 12.6% to 12.5%; under the model, the mean bias changes by up to 4.6 points.
blocks.zh: 我们测量了分批对损害和分级的叶子的表决结果:分区2和另外12个随机分级,在与表决运行时相同的GPU类型上进行分级,给出每个项目,连同分区0和1,15个独立分批(附录J,表18)。 他们的多数仍然不同于单一项目决定的8.4-17.8%(合12.6%[12.1,13.2]),而一批10.9-19.8%(合16.0%),因此15批只消除了大约五分之一的分歧。 与主要实验相适应的阈值模型预测了15个批次的大多数,平均绝对误差为0.6分(最多为1.5分)。 由于15个分区和单项中有3个重复了它所安装的提示,这一检查只是部分取出样本:仅在12个新分区上,它的误差就达到了1.6分,表13的9个分批决定中的无模型多数也预测了大约15分多数(指绝对误差0.5分)。 由于在每个分区中选择了批量阈值,使批量作出与单一项目分级一样多的肯定决定,大多数项目(集合10.4%[9.9,10.9])和未校准份额的82%仍然不同;只有Gemma-4和Granite的伤害问题,大约是分歧的一半。 因此,棒打不仅是围绕单项决定的噪音:大多数分歧是针对该项目的,对分批表决并不能去除. 然而,单项叙级并不是一种特殊的情况:在校正15个批次中的13个中,它与大多数不同,因为一个批次与其他14个中13个中的大多数不同(合为10.4%对11.0%;对定级的Granite来说,每对比较少的是3.4分;对定级的Granite来说,则比较多的是4.3分)。 分歧也并不意味着错误:在15个批次大多数与单项不同的物品上,多数与十对分中四对以上(最高为83%)的人类标签相匹配. 测量到的分歧也取决于单项的快取:随着RTX 5090的重写单项快取作为参考运行,每对变化为--4.5到+1.7分,虽然集合率只有12.6%到12.5%;在模型下,平均偏差变化可达4.6分.

blocks.en: 5.5 Two channels: texts and earlier verdicts
blocks.zh: 5.5 联合国 文本和先前的判决

blocks.en: Figure 3: Target decisions changed by editing one part of a generation, relative to the unedited forward pass: the earlier verdicts taken from a generation with other neighbours (texts kept), the neighbours’ texts taken from that generation (verdicts kept), or both.
blocks.zh: 图3:根据未经编辑的前进通行证,通过编辑一代人中一部分人更改了目标决定:早先由一代人与其他邻居(保存的文本)作出的判决、由下一代人(保存的文本)作出的判决,或两者兼有。

blocks.en: On harm and grading, the unedited intervention reproduces the generated verdict for 97.8–99.5% of the placements (a target in one slot): greedy decoding of the unedited forward pass, with exact ties broken as in the model’s generations, writes the same level. Most of the misses are near-ties, with the two most likely levels of the generation within 0.2 in probability, but 10 of the 50 misses on harm and grading are not (for Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B , at most 4 of about 400 placements per model and task), so the first condition of G3 holds only approximately. Figure 3 shows what changes when one channel is set to its value in a batch with other neighbours. Replacing only the earlier verdicts changes 7–23% of target decisions, replacing only the neighbours’ texts 9–26%; both channels act with similar strength, well above the 3% that G3 requires. Replacing both, which puts the other batch’s texts and verdicts into the answer of this generation, changes 9–22%: less than the sum of the two in every pair and less than either alone in seven of ten, so the channels overlap, and texts and verdicts that do not match can disturb the model more than a consistent context does.
blocks.zh: 在伤害和分级方面,未经编辑的干预转载了97.8-99.5%的安置(一个插槽中的目标):贪婪地对未经编辑的前进通行证进行解码,与模范的几代人一样断绝了确切的联系。 失事者多为近50人,两代人最有可能的级别在0.2以内,但50名失事者中有10名没有(就Qune3-4B和Qune3-8B而言,每个模型和任务最多有4名被安置),因此G3的第一个条件只维持了大约. 图3显示当一个信道与其他邻国的分批设定其价值时的变化。 仅取代先前的判决则改变7–23 % 的目标裁决,仅取代邻国的文本 9–26 % ; 两条渠道作用力相近,远高于G3所需要的3%。 取代两者,将其他批次的文本和判决纳入这一代人的答案中,变化了9–22 % : 低于每对中两个的和数,低于10个中的7个,因此渠道重叠,不匹配的文本和判决可能比一致上下文更能扰乱模型。

blocks.en: The verdict channel responds to its content, not only to its presence (Table 7 , Appendix D ). Lowering the earlier verdicts by one level, which leaves those at the lowest level unchanged, changes 8–54% of decisions, while shuffling the model’s own earlier verdicts changes 5–19%. Replacing them with the verdicts the model gives to the same neighbours alone changes only 2–12%. This is consistent with part of the effect travelling through the difference between the model’s batched and single-item verdicts on the neighbours, although verdicts that match the texts may also simply disturb the model less. Replacing every neighbour’s text by a dash, with the keys and the earlier verdicts kept, changes 12–41%, and letting the target be answered first changes 6–22%.
blocks.zh: 判决频道不仅回应其存在,而且回应其内容(附录D表7)。 将先前的判决降为一个级别,使最低级别的判决保持不变,则改变8-54%的判决,而推翻模型自己先前的判决则改变5-19 %。 用模型给同一邻居的判决来代替他们, 这与模型对邻居的分批裁定和单项裁定之间的差别部分影响是一致的,尽管与文本相符的判决也可能只是较少地扰乱模型。 让每个邻国的文本以一分之差取代,同时保留钥匙和先前的判决,改变12–41 % , 并且让目标被解答,改变6–22 % 。

blocks.en: The changes of the target’s probability make the same point (Proposition 11 , Table 14 ). If the channels added up on the scale of ζ \zeta , the interaction contrast J J would vanish. Instead its mean square is 0.7–2.5 times the mean of those of Δ T \Delta_{T} and Δ V \Delta_{V} , between 1.8 and 2.6, close to the factor 2 of four unrelated contexts, in nine of the ten pairs, and the two changes correlate at 0.26–0.63, where unrelated contexts give 0.5. On the scale of the target’s probability, the texts and the verdicts of a batch therefore do not contribute separate amounts, and changing either one is almost as much as drawing a new context. Nor do they add up on a latent scale that saturates near 0 and 1. If they added up on any scale that ζ \zeta increases with, a change of the texts could not move ζ \zeta in opposite directions under the two sets of verdicts, nor a change of the verdicts under the two sets of texts, so that the two consistent values ζ A ​ A \zeta_{AA} and ζ B ​ B \zeta_{BB} (the first index names the batch of the texts, the second that of the verdicts) could never both lie above, or both below, the two mismatched values ζ B ​ A \zeta_{BA} and ζ A ​ B \zeta_{AB} (Proposition 11 ). Yet for 8.7% of the 3,991 placements graded by the five models (a target in one slot, graded by one model; 0.0–13.8% per pair) both consistent values lie on the same side of both mismatched ones by more than 0.2. These placements carry 40% of the summed J 2 J^{2} , and in 95% of them the mismatched values are the ones closer to 0.5. Numerical noise can explain only part of this. If the channels added up, a crossing by more than 0.2 would need an error of more than half as much in one of the four values. Errors of the two consistent values explain at most 7 of the crossings: replacing these values by the probabilities read during the two generations (for ζ B ​ B \zeta_{BB} , the other generation in its own layout) leaves 342 of the 349 placements crossed, and replacing only ζ A ​ A \zeta_{AA} leaves 348. With the consistent values right, a crossing needs an error of more than 0.2 in one of the two mismatched values. The unedited forward pass and the probability read during generation differ by that much for 1.2% of the placements that are undecided at generation ( 0.1 < ζ < 0.9 0.1<\zeta<0.9 ) and for 1 of the 3,330 others. At these rates, applied to the level of each mismatched value of every placement, such errors are expected in at most 53 of the 3,991 placements, so numerical noise can account for at most about 60 of the 349 crossings, or 115 at the upper ends of the 95% intervals of the two rates, which rest on nine differences. Texts and verdicts that do not match leave the model less certain, although they rarely reverse, both at once, the decision that the two consistent contexts give: the four decisions cross in this way for only 1.8% of the placements.
blocks.zh: 目标概率的变化得出了同样的观点(建议11,表14)。 如果频道在 \\\ zeta 上加起来, 交互对比 J J 将会消失 。 相反,它的正方形是QQ T\Delta_{T}和V\Delta_{V}的平均值的0.7-2.5倍,介于1.8-2.6之间,接近四个不相干上下文的因子2,在十对中,有九对,而这两个变化相干于0.26-0.63,其中不相干上下文为0.5. 因此,在目标概率的尺度上,批次的文本和判决并不提供单独的金额,改变其中之一几乎等于勾画出新的背景。 它们的积分也不可能达到 接近0和1的饱和度 如果它们加起来,如果\\\\\\\\\\\\\xBB=(第一个索引将文本的批量取名,第二个判决书取名),则在两套判决下不能将\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ 然而,在5个模型分级的3 991个职位中,有8.7%(一个名额中的目标,一个模型分级;0.0–13.8%每对)两种一致的数值都位于两个不匹配的模型的同一边,比0.2以上。 这些投放携带了总和J 2 J^{2}的40%,其中95%的不匹配值接近0.5。 数字噪声只能解释其中的一部分. 如果信道相加,超过0.2的过道需要四个值中一个值超过一半的错误. 两个一致值的误差在大多数7个交叉点上解释:用两代人(对于ζ B\zeta\BB},另一代人)所读取的概率来取而代之,349个位置中,有342个交叉,只取而代之的是ζ A\zeta\A}出348个. 使用一致的值正确,在两个不匹配值中,一个交叉需要一个超过0.2的错误. 未经编辑的前传和在一代人期间读取的概率,与1.2%的未在一代人时决定的投放(0.1 < ____ < 0.9 < 0.1 > 泽塔 < 0.9)和另外3 330人中的1人不同。 根据这些比率,对每次安置的每个不匹配值的水平,预计在3 991次安置中,最多有53次出现这种出错,因此,在349次过境中,数字噪音最多可占大约60次,在两种比例的95%间隔中,数字噪音最多可占115次,这取决于9次差异。 与模型不相匹配的文本和判决使得模型的确定性更低,尽管它们很少同时逆转两种一致上下文给出的决定:四个判决以这种方式交叉,只有1.8%的投放.

blocks.en: 5.6 When it matters
blocks.zh: 5.6 国家 当它重要时

blocks.en: Figure 4: Top: flips between partitions 0 and 1 for items the model is sure or unsure about when graded alone (unsure: 0.1 < ζ < 0.9 0.1<\zeta<0.9 in the single-item prompt, where ζ = P ⁡ ( level ≥ τ ) \zeta=P(\text{level}\geq\tau) is read from the next-token distribution as in § 3 ); one line per model and task. Bottom: flips against single-item grading as the batch grows, harm and grading, one line per model and task.
blocks.zh: 图4: 顶部:对于单项标出时,模型的分区为0至1之间的翻转确定或不确定(不确定:0.1 < 0.9 < 0.1 > zeta < 0.9),其中:从下个标出时读取的分区为P(\text{level_ geq\tau),如§3;每个模型和任务一行. 底部:随着批量增加,伤害和分级,每条模型和任务一行相逆而上.

blocks.en: On harm and grading, confidence on single items protects only partly against batching (Figure 4 , top). Items the model is unsure about when graded alone flip 14–38% of the time between partitions, but items it is sure about still flip 6–21%, and the share of unsure items varies widely between models (2.4–47.8%). Star ratings are easy for all five main models (AUROC 0.96 against the true rating, compared with 0.72–0.83 on the other tasks): few reviews are uncertain (1.4–4.7%), and sure reviews flip only 2.2–3.5%. This makes star rating the boundary condition of our findings: batching changes the written rating but rarely a decision. For the five main models, stars also have the smallest dissimilarity on the latent scale: at the primary threshold D new D_{\mathrm{new}} is 0.005–0.008 against 0.06–0.24 on the other tasks, and at no threshold of the star scale does it exceed 0.043, less than at any threshold of harm and grading with at least 5% of the decisions on either side (0.057). How much smaller it is depends on the threshold, which an ordinal version of the threshold model would not allow (Table 15 , Appendix I ).
blocks.zh: 关于损害和分级,对单个项目的信任仅部分地防止分批(图4,上)。 模型对于在分区间进行14-38%的分级, 明星评分对所有五个主要模式来说都很简单(AUROC 0.96相对于真实评分,而在其他任务上则有0.72–0.83):几乎没有评论不确定(1.4–4.7%),肯定评论只翻出2.2–3.5%. 这使得恒星评级我们发现的边界条件:分批改变书面评级,但很少决定. 对于五种主要模型,恒星在潜在尺度上也有最小的同分性:在主阈值D新D_{\mathrm{new}}}在其他任务上为0.005-0.08相比于0.06-0.24相比;在恒星尺度的任何阈值上,恒星均不超过0.043相比,低于任何损害的阈值,并至少以5%的双方决定分级(0.057). 其规模有多大取决于阈值,而阈值模型的正则版本不允许(表15,附录一)。

blocks.en: Smaller batches help less than one might hope (Figure 4 , bottom). With five items per prompt, 9–16% of decisions already differ from single-item grading; with fifty, 12–23%. Within the Qwen3 family, size helps more against trivial prompt changes than against batching: renamed keys change 24.2%, 3.2% and 1.1% of decisions at 1.7B, 4B (the later Instruct-2507 release) and 8B, while batching changes 24.0%, 12.9% and 12.8% (Appendix F ); at 1.7B renamed keys change about as many decisions as batching, and from 4B to 8B renamed keys change a third as many decisions while batching changes about as many. On the main harm sample, Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-32B do not continue this pattern (Appendix J ): renamed keys change 2.1% of their single-item decisions, no fewer than for Qwen3-8B (Table 4 ), while a batch differs from single-item grading on 12.0% and 17.0%.
blocks.zh: 更小批量的帮助不到人们的希望(图4,下方)。 每起裁决有5项,9-16%的决定已经不同于单项分级;50项,12-23%。 在Qwen3家族中,大小比分批更有利于小的即时变化:在1.7B,4B(后导-2507发布)和8B(后导-2507发布)中,重名密钥改变24.0%,12.9%和12.8%(附录F)中,大小比分批量更有利于小的即时变化;在1.7B中,重名密钥改变约与分批量相同多的决定,从4B到8B更名密钥改变三分之一,再分批量变化约多. 在主要伤害样本上,Qune3-14B和Qune3-32B不延续这种模式(附录J): 重命名后键改变其单项决定的2.1%,不低于Qune3-8B(表4),而一批则与12.0%和17.0%的单项分级不同.

blocks.en: 6 Implications
blocks.zh: 6 影响

blocks.en: Accuracy on a labelled sample understates how much batching changes. A batched pipeline should report how many decisions differ from single-item grading and between two random partitions, next to baselines such as renamed keys, which need no labels.
blocks.zh: 标签样本上的精确度低估了批量变化的程度。 一个分批的管道应报告与单项分级和两个随机分区之间有多少决定不同,旁边是基准,如重新命名的密钥,不需要标签。

blocks.en: Voting over permutations leaves the main effect of membership and multiplies the cost. It divides the variance that order and slot, and their interaction with membership, add to the share of votes by the number of permutations (Proposition 4 ), but the flips by less than its square root: measured, five permutations leave 60–69% of the flips between batches and nine 52–60% (§ 5.4 ). Voting over batches converges to the main batched decision (Proposition 5 ): the majority of fifteen independent batches still differs from the single-item decision for 8.4–17.8% of the items (§ 5.4 ). In our earlier study, averaging six batches over three slots still left 10–24% of borderline decisions changed (Appendix G ). Recalibrating the threshold so that batches flag as many items as single-item grading removes only the part of the disagreement that is a shift of the operating point: about half of it for Gemma-4 and Granite on harm and less in the other pairs of the main models. The recalibrated majority of fifteen batches still differs from single-item grading on 7.9–13.5% of decisions (§ 5.4 ), and for the closed model of Appendix G recalibration left the changed decisions as they were. The reliable fix is separability by construction: one item per prompt, or a block attention mask under which each item and its verdict see only the shared instructions and that item, with keys and position ids that do not depend on the slot ( Bito et al., 2026 ; Glavas et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 投票推翻了选举,留下了会员制的主要影响,使成本倍增。 它将顺序和时段的相差以及它们与会员的相互作用除去相差的相差,将票数份额相加为相差数(建议4),但相差小于平方根: 测量,相差5个相差60-69%相差9个相差52-60%相差(§ 5.4). 分批表决与主要分批决定一致(建议5):15个独立分批表决的多数仍与8.4-17.8%的项目的单一项目决定不同(第5.4节)。 在先前的研究中,平均有六批分三档,但仍有10-24 %的边界决定发生变化(附录G)。 重新调整阈值,使分批标出像单项分级一样多的项目,只去除分歧中作为操作点移位的部分:大约一半用于Gemma-4和Granite在伤害上,而较少用于其他主要模型. 15个批次的重新校正多数仍然不同于对7.9-13.5%的决定(第5.4节)进行单一项目的分级,对于附录G的封闭式重新校正模式,则保留了已改变的决定。 可靠的固定方式是通过构造来分离:每个快件一个,或者一个块状的注意口罩,每个快件及其判断只见共同的指令和该物品,有不取决于槽的键和位置标识(Bito等,2026;Glavas等,2026.).

A batch costs S / k + L S/k+L per item if its prefix is billed in full, and c cache ​ S / k + L c_{\mathrm{cache}}S/k+L if it is read from the cache as well. This requires all shared text, including the request, to precede the item; our prompts put the request after the items and would need to be reordered. Anthropic’s models and OpenAI’s models from GPT-5.6 on bill cache reads at c cache ≤ 0.1 c_{\mathrm{cache}}\leq 0.1 (earlier OpenAI models at a model-dependent rate) but cache only prefixes of at least 512–4,096 tokens, depending on the model ( Anthropic, 2026b ; OpenAI, 2026 ) ; self-hosted serving reuses prefixes of any length ( Kwon et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) , which makes c cache c_{\mathrm{cache}} nearly zero, so that isolation costs about as much as batches with a cached prefix and less than batches without one. When the instructions are short and the items unambiguous, as for star ratings, batching may be acceptable, but that should be measured rather than assumed.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Batching several items into one prompt makes an LLM’s verdict on an ambiguous item depend on its company. On harm and short-answer grading, a new random partition changes about one decision in seven for five 4–9B models (14.8% on average) and one in ten for four 14–32B models (10.1%), mostly through the order of the neighbours and the slot but also through which items share the batch; in the 4–9B models, whose generations we edited, the effect travels through both the neighbours’ texts and the model’s own earlier verdicts. Because, under a threshold model, flips grow with the square root of the variance that the context contributes, accuracy understates the effect and voting removes it only slowly: for the 4–9B models, nine permutations of a batch leave more than half of the flips. Because batched verdicts differ systematically from single-item verdicts, even the majority of fifteen independent batches does not restore them. Where decisions matter to the people behind the items, graders should keep items apart or at least measure what batching changes.
blocks.zh: 将数件物品划入一时,LLM对一件模棱两可物品的裁决取决于该公司。 在伤害和短答分级方面,一个新的随机分区变化了五个4-9B模型的七个决定(平均14.8%)和四个14-32B模型的十个决定(10.1%),主要通过邻居的顺序和时间档,但也通过项目分享批次;在我们编辑的4-9B模型中,效果通过邻居的文本和模型自己早先的判决。 因为在一个阈值模型下,翻转会随着上下文所促成的差异的平方根而增长,准确度低估了效果,而表决只会慢慢地去掉: 对于4-9B模型来说,一个批量的9个通量会留下超过半数的翻转. 由于分批判决与单项判决有系统差异,甚至15个独立分批判决中的多数没有恢复. 如果决定对项目背后的人很重要,分级员应把项目分开,或至少衡量分批的变动。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our main models are open-weight and have 4–9B parameters. Four larger ones, with 14–32B parameters, repeat only the core design on harm and grading, on another type of GPU, without star ratings, other batch sizes, interventions or voting; the Qwen3 family has two of them, the Gemma-4 and GLM-4 families one each and the Granite family none. Proprietary models may be more or less sensitive. Within Qwen3 our models run from 1.7B to 32B, and the 4B model is a later release. The closed model of Appendix G answers per item against a shared context rather than in one JSON generation, so it does not test the verdict channel. We study three English tasks with one prompt template and one reworded variant, JSON output and greedy decoding; under the reworded variant a new partition still changes 6.1–21.0% of decisions on harm and grading, slightly fewer than under the original wording (Appendix J ). Other formats, such as asking for one verdict at a time within a conversation, may behave differently. The decomposition of the flip rate is exact in expectation for the main effect of membership, up to the few items without a valid verdict. The split between order and the interaction of slot and membership rests on the five designated slots of “keep slot, reorder the others”, which reorder only 20 of the 24 neighbours and which we reweight because the first slot is less sensitive than the others; the membership share that we fixed before the runs does not allow for this and overstates the effect of membership. The latent scale, the model’s predictions for voting and its estimate of the bias assume a Gaussian threshold model in which the context contributes the same variance for all items, and the estimate of the bias also assumes that the single-item score is jointly normal with the mean of the item over contexts; what voting over up to nine permutations and fifteen batches leaves is measured without the model, for the five main models on harm and grading only (on stars the bias rests on the model and on three partitions). The model predicts, with a mean absolute error below one point, most patterns of the main experiment to which it was not fitted, but it over-predicts the flips between majority votes and under-predicts the items whose decisions in fifteen batches are not all equal (by +1.8 [+1.4, +2.2] points, measured minus predicted; § 5.3 ), which suggests that the context matters more for some items than for others. Fitted to the voting runs, it predicts within a point the flip rates that permutation voting leaves; its predictions from the main design, made before these runs, missed by − - 2.0 to +2.2 points (predicted minus measured; § 5.4 ). The latent dissimilarity depends on the threshold of the scale, by a factor of 1.4–2.8 on harm and 3.2–5.2 on stars. The interventions edit tokens inside a generation: the most extreme edits (all earlier verdicts at the lowest level) produce contexts the model would not write itself, and we base our conclusions about the two channels on swaps between natural generations. Most intervals treat items as independent; treating the items that share a generated prompt as clustered reduces the pairs whose interval for the main effect of membership excludes zero from six to five, and the clustered intervals of the voting experiment exclude zero in all ten. Finally, bf16 inference makes the edited forward pass differ slightly from generation with a cache; the unedited check reproduces 97.8–99.5% of verdicts on harm and grading, and all effects are measured against it.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要模型是开放量子,有4–9B参数. 有4个更大的,有14–32B参数,只重复关于伤害和分级的核心设计,在另一种类型的GPU上,没有明星评分,其他批量大小,干预或投票;Quen3家族有2个,Gemma-4和GLM-4家族各一个,而Granite家族没有. 专有模型可能或多或少具有敏感性. 在Quen3内部,我们的模型从1.7B跑到32B,4B模型是后期发行. 附录G的闭合模型根据一个共同的上下文回答每个项目,而不是在一个JSON一代中,因此不测试判断道. 我们研究三个英文任务,一个是即时模板和一个重写变体,JSON输出和贪婪地解码;在重写变体下,一个新的分块仍然会改变关于伤害和分级的决定的6.1-21.0%,略低于原先的措辞(附录J). 其他形式,如在谈话中一次要求一个判决,可能行为不同. 翻转率的分解是准确的,期望会员制的主要效果,直到少数没有有效判决的项目. 顺序和时间档与成员之间的相互作用取决于“保留时间档,重新安排其他时间档”的五个指定时间档,这24个邻国中只有20个重新排序,我们重新加权,因为第一个时间档比其他时间档更敏感;我们在选举之前确定的成员份额不允许这样做,而且过分夸大了成员的影响。 潜在比例、模型对投票的预测和对偏差的估计假设了一个高斯阈值模型,在这个模型中,上下文对所有项目都造成同样的差异,对偏差的估计还假设单项得分与项目上下文的平均值是共同正常的;在没有模型的情况下,对最多9个通量和15个批量叶子的表决是没有模型的,因为只有关于伤害和分级的5个主要模型(关于恒星的偏差取决于模型和3个分区)。 该模型以1分以下的平均绝对误差来预测其未被搭配的主要实验的大部分模式,但过度预测了多数票数之间的翻转和未充分预测其十五批决定并非全部相等的项目(以+1.8分[+1.4分,+2.2分]计分,以负预测;第5.3分),这表明上下文对某些项目比其他项目更重要. 与投票运行相适应的,它预言在一分之内,即轮回投票的翻转率;它在这些运行之前从主要设计中作出的预测,错失了−-2.0到+2.2分(预估的负数;§ 5.4). 潜在的差异取决于天平的阈值,损害系数为1.4-2.8,恒星系数为3.2-5.2。 干预在一代人内部编辑符号:最极端的编辑(所有早期在最下层的判断)会产生模型不会自己写出的背景,我们把两个渠道的结论建立在自然世代之间的互换上. 多数间隔将项目视为独立的;将共享生成的即时项目作为分组处理,将成员主要作用的间隔从0排除为6至5的对数减少,将表决实验的分组间隔在所有10个中排除为0. 最后,bf16推论使经过编辑的前传与代相去甚远,缓存;未经编辑的支票转载了97.8-99.5%的伤害和分级判决,所有影响都以它来衡量。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: The harm task uses comments that contain hate speech; we do not quote any of them. Measuring Hate Speech is released under CC BY 4.0 and SciEntsBank under CC BY-SA 3.0 (the Hugging Face copy that we used is labelled CC BY 4.0). Yelp Review Full is used under the Yelp Dataset Terms of Use; we submitted our findings to Yelp for review before publication. For its reviews we release only their row numbers in the test set, not their texts, star ratings or model outputs. Our findings concern decisions that affect people, such as removing a comment or grading an answer; they argue for measuring the arbitrariness that batching introduces before deploying it. The main experiment ran on five rented RTX 5090 instances, one per model, and the population study of Appendix F on two rented RTX 5090 instances, one model at a time; the open-model runs of Appendix G used a shared RTX 5090 server and rented instances, and the closed model its API. The follow-up experiments of Appendix J ran on a shared university cluster, one H200 NVL per model, for about 15 GPU-hours.
blocks.zh: 伤害任务使用含有仇恨言论的评论;我们不引用其中任何一句。 "衡量仇恨言论"在CC BY 4.0下发布,"SciEntsBank"在CC BY-SA 3.0下发布(我们使用的"拥抱脸"副本被贴上CC BY 4.0标签). Yelp Review Full在 Yelp 数据集的使用条款下使用;我们向 Yelp 提交了我们的调查结果,供其在发布前审查。 在它的评论中,我们只公布他们在测试集中的行号,而不是他们的文本,明星评分或模型输出. 我们的调查结果涉及影响人们的决定,例如删除评论或对答案进行分级;它们主张在进行分批处理之前衡量其任意性。 主实验运行在5个租用的RTX 5090个例上,每个型号1个;在2个租用的RTX 5090个例上对附录F进行人口研究,一次一个型号;附录G的开放型跑使用了共享的RTX 5090服务器和租用例,封闭型号的API. 附录J的后续实验运行在一个共享的大学集群上,每个模型一个H200NVL,大约15个GPU小时.

blocks.en: Data and Code Availability
blocks.zh: 数据和代码可用性

blocks.en: The experimental designs, the runner and analysis scripts, and the model outputs behind the tables and figures (parsed verdicts, level distributions and JSON answers), except the outputs for the Yelp reviews, will be available at https://github.com/PX-CPS/Judged_in_company , together with the designs, job scripts and outputs of the follow-up experiments of Appendix J . Without the outputs for the Yelp reviews, the star-rating results and the few numbers that pool the three tasks (the changes of the written level in § 5.1 , the smoke tests of the footnote on G3 and the counts of valid verdicts in Appendix H ) can be reproduced only by running the models on the corpus with the released designs and runner. Appendix G and the two statements of the paragraph on mitigation that cite it rest on our earlier study of Chinese moderation data, with the closed model and open models, whose data we do not release. The texts of the items come from the original corpora and are not redistributed, except the grading item shown in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 除了Yelp审查的产出外,实验设计、跑步和分析脚本以及表格和数字背后的模型产出(平面判断、级别分布和JSON答案),将在https://github.com/PX-CPS/Judged_in_company网站上查阅,以及附录J的后续试验的设计、工作脚本和产出。 没有Yelp评论的产出,星平结果和集合了这三项任务的少数数字(第5.1节中书面水平的变化,G3上脚注的烟雾测试和附录H中有效判决的计数)只能通过使用释放出的设计与跑道来运行本体上的模型来复制. 附 录 G和关于缓解的段落中引述这一段落的两个说法,都取自我们早先对中国温和数据的研究,其中封闭模型和开放模型,我们不公布它们的数据。 除图1所示的分级项目外,这些项目的文本来自原公司,不重新分配。

blocks.en: Appendix A Prompts
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en: Every prompt has the form below, shown for grading; the opening line, the scale, the context line, the header and name of the items and the question differ by task.
blocks.zh: 每个提示有下面的表格,用于分级;打开行,尺度,上下文行,标题和项目名称以及问题因任务而异.

blocks.en: You grade students' short answers to science questions on this scale: 0 = Incorrect: the answer contradicts the reference answer, or is irrelevant or off-topic 1 = Partially correct: the answer has part of the reference answer's content but is incomplete 2 = Correct: the answer conveys the content of the reference answer, in any wording Context: Each item gives a question, a reference answer and one student's answer. Spelling and grammar do not matter. Each answer is graded on its own. Answers: c0: Question: … Reference answer: … Student's answer: … c1: … Question: How correct is each student's answer? Answer with a JSON object that maps every answer id to a single digit from 0 to 2, in the form {"c0": <level>, "c1": <level>, ...}, and nothing else.

blocks.en: The harm prompt opens with “You grade comments for harm on this scale:”, lists the comments under “Comments:” and asks “How harmful is each comment?” for digits from 0 to 4; its scale has five levels from safe (ordinary chat, reactions, criticism that attacks no one) to dangerous (credible threats, encouragement of self-harm). The star prompt opens with “You predict how many stars a customer gave, from the text of the review, on this scale:”, lists the reviews under “Reviews:” and asks “How many stars did each customer give?” for digits from 1 to 5, one per star. The reworded variant changes the opening (for grading “Rate each student’s answer against the reference answer, using these levels:”, for harm “Rate how harmful each comment is, using these levels:”, for stars “Estimate the star rating that goes with each review, using these levels:”) and the request (for grading “Which level fits each student’s answer? Reply with a JSON object whose keys are the answer ids…”, and in the same way “Which level fits each comment?” and “Which rating fits each review?”). The context lines of grading (above) and stars (“Reviews of local businesses written by customers. Each review is rated on its own.”) tell the model that each item is graded on its own; the harm context line (“Comments posted on social media (YouTube, Reddit and Twitter).”) only says where the comments come from.

blocks.en: The order component is estimated from the weighted designated slots, as for the data; since all slots are alike here, the weights change only the precision of the estimate. Over 12 simulations, the estimators returned 0.13 (0.02), 0.41 (0.03), 0.24 (0.03) and 0.22 (0.05) (mean and standard deviation over simulations), and the bootstrap intervals covered the true shares in 12, 11, 11 and 12 of the simulations. The order share is slightly too high because the estimator of D D overstates it in the small tables of the designated slots (§ 3 ). We also simulated voting over 3, 5 and 9 permutations of the batches of two partitions. The votes of the two batches differed for 20.2%, 18.4% and 16.8% of the items, against 19.6%, 17.7% and 16.0% predicted from the estimated dissimilarities by Proposition 4 and 19.8%, 17.9% and 16.2% from the true ones. With 25 slots the model satisfies Assumption 2 only approximately: two permutations can put the item in the same slot, and the rest of its score given the item and the membership is then a mixture over its 25 slot values, not a normal variable. Simulated directly with 16,000,000 items, its votes differ for 20.0%, 18.1% and 16.4% of the items, 0.16–0.17 points above the formula at the true dissimilarities (Monte Carlo standard error at most 0.01 points); the simulations on the design lie within 1.9 standard errors of their mean from these values (standard error up to 0.29 points over the 12 simulations). The true mean bias was 11.5%. The model gave 11.7% and the bound of Equation ( 4 ) − - 1.2%, which is valid but not informative here. The majority of the nine batched decisions differed from the single-item decision for 14.5% of the items: it overstates the bias when the context carries as much variance as in this simulation ( synthetic_check.py ).
blocks.zh: 与数据一样,顺序部分是从加权指定时间段估算出来的;由于所有时间段都在这里相同,权重只改变估计数的精确度。 超过12起模拟,估计器返回了0.13 (0.02),0.41 (0.03),0.24 (0.03)和0.22 (0.05) (与模拟相比的平均值和标准偏差),靴子间隔涵盖了模拟中12起,11起,11起和12起的真实份额. 订单份额略高,因为D的估测器在指定档次的小表格中将其夸大(§3). 我们还模拟了对两个分区的分批3、5和9个轮廓的投票。 两个批次的投票率分别是20.2%、18.4%和16.8%,分别是19.6%、17.7%和16.0%,分别与提案4和19.8%、17.9%和16.2%的估计不同。 模型有25个插槽,只满足了假定2:两个通体可以将项目放入同一个插槽,其余的分数则给项目和成员带来25个插槽值的混合,而不是一个正常变量。 直接用16,000,000个项目模拟,它的得票率分别是20.0%,18.1%和16.4%,在真正相异时比公式高出0.16–0.17分(蒙特卡洛标准误差最多为0.01分);对设计进行的模拟在于其平均值的1.9个标准误差(标准误差最高为12个模拟差0.29分). 真正的平均偏差为11.5%。 该模型给出了11.7%,方程式约束(4个)−-1.2%,这在这里是有效的,但并不说明情况. 9个批次决定的大多数与14.5%的项目的单一项目决定不同:当上下文具有与模拟相同多的差异时(合成-check.py.),它夸大了偏差。

blocks.en: Before the main experiment we graded 2,000 random comments from the same corpus with the harm prompt and protocol of the main experiment and seven models (Table 8 ); 258 of them are also in the main experiment’s harm sample. Qwen3-0.6B returned only 674 valid verdicts of the 6,000 it had to write in batches of 25 (2,000 comments in each of three partitions) and is omitted. The results agree with the main experiment and show a trend with size within Qwen3 up to 8B, whose 4B model is a later release (Instruct-2507) than the 1.7B and 8B models; on the main harm sample, a new partition changes about as many decisions for Qwen3-32B as for Qwen3-8B (Tables 2 and 16 ).
blocks.zh: 在主要实验之前,我们从同一体中分出2000个随机评论,其中主要实验的伤害即时和协议以及七个模型(表8);其中258个也是主要实验的伤害样本. Quen3-0.6B只归还了它不得不分批写出6000个有效判决的674个(3个分区各有2,000个评论),被省略. 结果与主实验一致并显示出一个在Qwen3至8B范围内的大小趋势,其4B模型是比1.7B和8B模型的后期释放(指令-2507);在主危害样本上,新的分区变化与Qune3-32B和Qune3-8B(表2和16)一样多的决定.

blocks.en: Appendix G Replication on Chinese moderation data

blocks.en: We first observed the effect in a moderation system for Chinese video comments that uses a closed, probability-returning model (Jev 1.13) with 16 comments per request. On the COLD ( Deng et al., 2022 ) and ToxiCN ( Lu et al., 2023 ) test sets, grading in batches of 16 instead of one comment per request changed 9.2% and 10.7% of decisions at level 2, against 1.7% and 1.5% between two runs of the same batches, while AUROC fell by 0.018 and 0.004. Regrouping the comments by topic instead of file order, at the same batch size, changed 6.7% and 8.7% of decisions, more than rewording the rubric (5.8% and 7.1%). Recalibrating the batched threshold to reproduce the single-comment flag rate left the changed decisions as they were (COLD 6.5% before and 6.6% after, ToxiCN 8.9% and 8.6%; here the decision is on the expected level, so the rates differ from those above), which shows that batching reorders comments rather than shifting them all. A controlled design with fixed targets and chosen neighbours, run on the closed model and the five open models of the main experiment, showed the same effect for all of them except GLM-4, whose verdicts rarely reached the decision threshold although its probabilities moved. It also showed that removing the phrase “read in context” from the question, quoting the target inside the question, or checking that the model can copy the target verbatim does not remove the effect. In the same design (144 comments that are borderline for the closed model, batches of 16 with benign or harmful neighbours), averaging the verdict distributions of six batches, three slots with two draws of neighbours each, still left 10–24% of decisions different from single-comment grading for the closed model, Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-4B and Gemma-4.
blocks.zh: 我们首先观察了中国视频评论节制系统的效果,该系统使用闭合的概率回放模型(Jev 1.13),每个请求有16个评论. 关于COLD(Deng等,2022年)和ToxiCN(Lu等,2023年)的成套测试,按批次划分为16个,而不是每个请求一个评论,在2级决定中变化了9.2%和10.7%,而同一批次中两个批次之间的决定比例为1.7%和1.5%,而AUROC下降了0.018和0.004。 按主题重排评论,而不是按文件顺序,按相同的批量大小,改变6.7%和8.7%的决定,超过重排标题(5.8%和7.1%). 重新调整批量阈值以复制单倍分量旗率,留下了改变的决定原样(COLD前6.5%和后6.6%,ToxiCN8.9%和8.6%;这里决定的是预期水平,因此比例与以上不同),这表明批量重新排序评论而不是全部转移. 一个有固定目标和选定邻居的可控设计,运行在封闭模型上和主实验的5个开放模型上,对除GLM-4之外的所有它们都表现出同样的效果,GLM-4的判断虽然其概率移动了,却很少达到决定阈值. 它还表明,从问题中删除“在上下文中阅读”一语,引用问题中的目标,或检查模型可以逐字复制目标,并不能消除效果。 在同一设计中(144个评论是封闭模型的分界线,16个批次与良性或有害的邻居),平均6个批次的判定分布,3个分档各有2个邻居的图案,仍然留下10–24%的决定与封闭模型的单分分级不同,Qune3-8B,Qune3-4B和Gemma-4.

blocks.en: The derived conditions are built from a base partition as follows. The reordered batch puts the members of every batch in a new uniformly random order. For keep slot, new neighbours , the batch with index b b takes, for every slot j j , the item that the base partition has in slot j j of the batch with index b − j b-j modulo n / k n/k . For keep slot, reorder the others , the items in the designated slots K = { 0 , 6 , 12 , 18 , 24 } K=\{0,6,12,18,24\} keep their slots and the others are put in a new uniformly random order among the other slots. For a condition let F ^ \hat{F} be the observed share of items whose decision differs from the base partition, measured on all items, on the items in a designated slot s s for the last condition ( F ^ keep , s \hat{F}_{\text{keep},s} ), or on the items that keep their slot in the reordered batch ( F ^ chance \hat{F}_{\mathrm{chance}} ). Items without a valid verdict in one of the two conditions are left out, and so are items without a valid single-item verdict; in every condition they are at most 13 of the 2,000 items of a task. The patterns of decisions, the comparisons with single-item grading, the error rates against the labels in § 5.2 and the thresholds (Tables 11 , 13 and 15 and the numbers taken from them) use only the items with a valid verdict in the three single-item conditions and in the nine batched conditions of the three partitions (the partitions, their reordered batches and their batches with new neighbours), at least 1,971 per model and task, so their rates can differ slightly from those of Table 4 ; Table 3 uses the items with a valid verdict alone and in the three partitions. blocks.en: Assumption 1 describes a large population of items and contexts. With finitely many of them it can hold only approximately: the scores take finitely many values, and a redrawn factor equals the old one with positive probability ( 1 / k 1/k for the slot). The assumption also forces the effects of the context to be normal given the item, with the same variance for all items. Let Z Z and Z ′ Z^{\prime} be the scores of a random item in its contexts in two independent partitions, and δ \delta and δ ′ \delta^{\prime} their deviations from the mean of the item, which are independent with the same law given the item (Lemma 1 ). By the assumption Z − Z ′ = δ − δ ′ Z-Z^{\prime}=\delta-\delta^{\prime} is 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 2 ​ D new ) \mathcal{N}(0,2D_{\mathrm{new}}) , and its law is a mixture over items of the laws of δ − δ ′ \delta-\delta^{\prime} , whose characteristic functions are non-negative. For any set of items, the part of the mixture that comes from these items therefore has a density at most that of 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 2 ​ D new ) \mathcal{N}(0,2D_{\mathrm{new}}) and a non-negative characteristic function at most that of 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 2 ​ D new ) \mathcal{N}(0,2D_{\mathrm{new}}) . By Hardy’s theorem ( Hardy, 1933 ) this part is a multiple of 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 2 ​ D new ) \mathcal{N}(0,2D_{\mathrm{new}}) , so δ − δ ′ \delta-\delta^{\prime} is 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 2 ​ D new ) \mathcal{N}(0,2D_{\mathrm{new}}) given almost every item, and by Cramér’s theorem ( Cramér, 1936 ) δ \delta is then 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , D new ) \mathcal{N}(0,D_{\mathrm{new}}) given the item. We therefore treat it as a model and compare its predictions with patterns of decisions to which it was not fitted (Appendix I ).

blocks.en: Independent memberships of an item have independent effects, and independent arrangements have independent rests given the item and their memberships, because the contexts are independent. Under Assumption 2 , the scores of an item in two contexts are bivariate normal with correlation 1 − D new 1-D_{\mathrm{new}} if the contexts are independent and 1 − D resh 1-D_{\mathrm{resh}} if they share their membership and their arrangements are independent, as for a batch and its reordering (Assumption 1 ); the assumption does not specify pairs that also share the slot, as in the two “keep slot” conditions. Like Assumption 1 , it can hold only approximately with finitely many slots. It follows from Assumption 1 for the new partition and the reordered batch if D resh > 0 D_{\mathrm{resh}}>0 and D new < 1 D_{\mathrm{new}}<1 ( D resh ≤ D new D_{\mathrm{resh}}\leq D_{\mathrm{new}} holds by Proposition 2 ). The argument of the previous subsection, with the item and its membership in place of the item, makes e e normal with variance D resh D_{\mathrm{resh}} given the item and the membership, and so independent of the membership given the item. Since a + e a+e is normal with variance D new D_{\mathrm{new}} given the item, Cramér’s theorem makes a a normal with variance D new − D resh = V N D_{\mathrm{new}}-D_{\mathrm{resh}}=V_{N} given the item. blocks.en: Tables 10 to 15 give the results of the main experiment behind Sections 5.3 to 5.5 for its five models on harm and grading (Appendix J gives the follow-up experiments); Tables 11 , 13 and 15 also give stars, whose D new D_{\mathrm{new}} is too small to decompose (§ 5.3 ). If all levels threshold one latent score, as in an ordinal version of the threshold model, the latent dissimilarity between two partitions would be the same at every threshold of the scale. Between the thresholds that have at least 5% of the decisions on either side, the largest dissimilarity is 1.0–2.2 times the smallest on grading, where four of the five models are below 1.2, 1.4–2.8 times on harm, where it grows with the threshold for four of the five models, and 3.2–5.2 times on stars, where all four thresholds qualify and the primary threshold gives the smallest dissimilarity for five of the five models. A context that contributes more variance to some items than to others, or items whose scores are not normal, such as the five rating classes of stars, make the dissimilarity depend on the threshold; the dissimilarities that we report describe the primary decision.
blocks.zh: 表10至15给出了5.3至5.5节后面的主要实验结果,用于其五个关于伤害和分级的模型(附录J给出后续实验); 表11、13和15还给出了恒星,其新的D_{\mathrm{new}}}太小无法分解(§ 5.3). 如果所有级别都有一个潜在分数,如阈值模型的正则版,两个分数之间的潜在分数在比额表的每个分数上都是一样的。 在两边至少有5%决定的阈值之间,最大的差值为分级时的1.0至2.2倍,其中5个模型中的4个低于1.2;在伤害时为1.4至2.8倍,与5个模型中的4个模型的阈值相加;在恒星上为3.2至5.2倍,其中所有4个阈值都符合条件,而初级阈值为5个模型中的5个模型的最小差值。 对某些项目比对其它项目造成更大差异的上下文,或者得分不正常的项目,如恒星的五个分级类,使得相差性取决于阈值;我们报告的不同性描述了主决定.
