blocks.en: After the main experiment, and without gates fixed in advance, we ran three follow-ups on harm and grading, on H200 NVL GPUs with torch 2.11 and transformers 5.17, in bf16 with greedy decoding and the prompt templates of the main experiment (model revisions in the footnote of § 4 ). Before its run, every model passed a smoke test of 44 prompts whose answers all had to parse, and recomputations from the raw records, mostly without our analysis code, reproduced every point estimate below.
blocks.zh: 在主实验之后,没有事先固定的门,我们对伤害和分级进行了三次跟踪,对H200 NVL GPU进行了火炬2.11和变压器5.17,在bf16中进行了贪婪的解码和主实验的即时模板(第4节脚注中的模型修订). 在运行前,每个模型都通过了44个提示的烟雾测试, 他们的答案都得分析, 从原始记录中重述, 大多没有我们的分析代码,

blocks.en: Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-32B with thinking disabled, Gemma-4-31B-it and GLM-4-32B-0414 grade the single items with their two baselines, the three partitions with their three derived conditions (Table 1 ), the baselines of partition 0, and partition 1 with the reworded instruction (Table 16 ). A new partition changes 5.9–14.6% of their decisions, 4.2–9.1 points above the largest baseline, which is the reworded instruction in all eight pairs; every lower bound is about 3 points or more, so every pair clears the bar of G1 (stars, on which G1 failed for the main models, was not run). By the measure fixed before the runs, the bar of G2 is cleared in five of the eight pairs, on both tasks only for Gemma-4-31B and GLM-4-32B ; with the designated slots weighted as in a random partition (§ 5.3 ), only in two, for Gemma-4-31B and GLM-4-32B on harm. The excess over the largest baseline is smaller for Gemma-4-31B than for Gemma-4 and for GLM-4-32B than for GLM-4 on both tasks, and in Qwen3 it falls with size on grading but not on harm; with one larger model in each of the other two families, another chat template and output format for Gemma-4-31B (an empty thought channel, fenced JSON), and another type of GPU, this does not establish a trend with size. A batch disagrees with single-item grading on 5.8–17.9% of decisions, and the bound of Equation ( 4 ) excludes zero in six of the eight pairs. Once the batched threshold is chosen in every partition so that batches give as many positive decisions as single-item grading, the bound falls by more than half in five of these six pairs and excludes zero clearly only for Qwen3-14B and Gemma-4-31B on harm (and only just for Qwen3-14B on grading). The bound reacts strongly to a shift of the operating point: for the main models, the same recalibration of their runs in the main experiment removes more than half of it in four of the eight pairs in which it excludes zero, although, pooled, the majority of fifteen batches keeps 82% of its disagreement after recalibration (§ 5.4 ). How much of the bias of the larger models is such a shift therefore remains open. Under the threshold model, which we did not check with more partitions for them, the mean bias is 4.1–17.1%. With the reworded instruction a new partition changes 6.1–13.0% of decisions, − - 1.6 to +0.2 points against the original wording. Order and slot carry most of D new D_{\mathrm{new}} for Qwen3-14B , Qwen3-32B and GLM-4-32B , as for the main models, although four of their six estimates of the interaction of slot and membership are negative ( − - 0.16 to − - 0.05, all with intervals that include zero). For Gemma-4-31B , D new D_{\mathrm{new}} is 0.018–0.030, and the estimated share of the interaction on grading, − - 0.37 [ − - 0.77, − - 0.06], has an interval below zero, which Proposition 2 excludes; we do not decompose it (§ 5.3 ). On harm, the four models put 36–52% of the comments on level 3 when they grade them alone and 21–39% in batches, so that their single-item levels tie more often; the AUROC of the expected level, which has no ties, changes by − - 0.023 to +0.012 on harm and grading (§ 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: Qwen3-14B和Qwen3-32B 具有思维残疾,Gemma-4-31B-it和GLM-4-32B-0414 将单项分为两个基线,三个分区及其三个衍生条件(表1),分区0的基线,分区1的重写指令(表16). 新的分区会改变5.9–14.6%的决定,比最大基线高4.2–9.1分,这是所有8对的重写指令;每个下限大约为3分或更多,因此每对都清除了G1的条(恒星,G1在主型号上失败了,但没有运行). 按照运行前所固定的测量标准,G2的条被清除为8对中的5对,这两个任务只为Gemma-4-31B和GLM-4-32B;指定槽被加权为随机分区(§ 5.3),只有2对,为Gemma-4-31B和GLM-4-32B的伤害. Gemma-4-31B的超标量比Gemma-4和GLM-4-32B的超标量都小,在Qwen3中,超标量随分级而下降,但不会造成伤害;另外两个家族各有一个更大的模型,Gemma-4-31B(一个空想道,有栅栏JSON)的聊天模板和输出格式,而另一种类型的GPU,这并没有确立出一个有大小的趋势. 有一批人不同意对5.8-17.9%的决定进行单项分级,方程式(4)的约束排除了8对中的6对中的0. 一旦在每一个分区中选择分批的阈值,使分批作出与单项分级一样多的正数决定,约束在这六对分中分出五分多半,并且明确排除了只有关于伤害的Qwen3-14B和Gemma-4-31B的零分数(仅限关于分级的Quen3-14B分数). 约束对操作点的转变反应强烈:对于主要模型来说,在主实验中相同的运行重排消除了超过一半的8对中的4对,其中排除了0,虽然集合,15批的大部分在重排后保留了82%的分歧(§ 5.4). 因此,较大模型的偏差有多大,这种偏差仍未改变。 在阈值模型中,我们没有检查更多的分区,平均偏差为4.1-17.1%。 重新措辞后,新的分区更改了6.1-13.0%的决定,−-1.6至+0.2点与原措词相对. 顺序和档位携带了大部分新的D_{\-mathrm{new}}-为Qune3-14B,Qune3-32B和GLM-4-32B,与主要型号一样,虽然它们六个档位和会籍相互作用的估计中,有四个是负数(−0.16至−-0.05,所有间隔都为零). 对Gemma-4-31B来说,新的D_{\mathrm{new}} = 0.018-0.030,在分级上的相互作用的估计份额为−-0.37 [−---0.77--0.06],间隔低于零,建议2排除;我们不分解(§ 5.3). 关于危害,这四个模型将36-52%的评论放在第3级,当它们单独分级的时候,将21-39%的评论放在分批进行,以便它们的单项水平更经常地相接;没有关联的预期水平的AUROC,在危害和分级上变化了−-0.023到+0.012(§ 5.2)。

blocks.en: Every batch of partitions 0 and 1 was graded in its own order, p0, and in eight further uniformly random orders of the same members, together with the single items and, with the reworded instruction, partitions 0 and 1 (7,200 prompts per model). Table 17 gives the flips between the majority votes of the two partitions over m m orders, averaged over all sets of m m of the nine orders of each partition, and the share of the flips of single orders that is left after nine permutations. The statistics use the items with a verdict in all eighteen orders (at least 1,977 of 2,000); their intervals are normal, with a variance clustered by the batches of both partitions ( Cameron et al., 2011 ) . Fitted to the same runs, the threshold model (Proposition 4 ) over-predicts the flips after m m permutations by 0.2–0.3 points when pooled, significantly after Holm’s adjustment in two, two, one and none of the ten pairs at m = 3 m=3 , 5, 7 and 9. On the scale of decisions, the main effect of membership, half the difference between the flips across the two partitions and those between orders of the same batch, is 0.38–0.81 points, and on the latent scale it is 0.11–0.22 of D new D_{\mathrm{new}} ; on both scales its interval excludes zero in all ten pairs. Against single items, the majority of the nine orders of one batch still differs for 9.1–18.6% of the items (one order: 11.2–19.7%), because voting over permutations converges to the decision given the membership. With the reworded instruction a new partition changes 9.9–21.0% of decisions, − - 1.9 to +0.1 points against order p0 in the original wording; over this experiment and the previous one, it changes fewer decisions than under the original wording in 16 of the 18 model–task pairs.

blocks.en: Order p0 repeats the prompts of partitions 0 and 1 of the main experiment. On the H200, 0.4–2.8% of these decisions per partition differ from the RTX 5090 run. On partition 0, where the main experiment measured numerical noise by generating the same prompts one at a time on the RTX 5090 (§ 4 ), this share minus that noise is − - 0.3 to +0.4 points; partition 1 has no such baseline and reaches 2.8%. The flips between the partitions change by − - 0.1 to +1.1 points, and the interval of this change excludes zero in one of the ten pairs. Partition 2, which the voting over batches below grades again, differs from the RTX 5090 run for 0.5–1.8% of the decisions.
blocks.zh: 命令p0重复了主实验分区0和1的提示. 在H200上,每个分区的决定有0.4-2.8%与RTX 5090运行不同. 在分区0上,主要实验通过在RTX 5090(§ 4)上一次生成同一种导出来测量数值噪声,这个分量减去噪音为−-0.3至+0.4分;分区1没有这样的基线并达到2.8%. 分区之间的翻转以− - 0.1到+1.1分变化,而这一变化的间隔排除了十对中的一对零. 第2分会再次对低于等级的批次进行投票,与RTX 5090跑跑0.5-1.8%的决定不同.

blocks.en: Partition 2 of the main experiment and twelve new uniformly random partitions were graded once each (2,080 prompts per model); with partitions 0 and 1 (order p0) and the single items of the voting runs, every item has fifteen independent batches and a single-item decision from the same type of GPU, driver and software. Table 18 gives the share of items whose majority over M M random batches, averaged over all sets of M M of the fifteen partitions, differs from the single-item decision; it changes by at most 0.7 points between nine and fifteen batches. The statistics use the items with a verdict alone and in all fifteen partitions (1,975–2,000). Their intervals are normal, with a variance computed from the influence of every item (delete-one jackknife), clustered by the batches of all fifteen partitions and not below the variance for independent items; on synthetic decisions from the threshold model with effects shared within batches, such intervals covered the true values in 95–99% of the simulations. The calibrated statistics, whose cuts are quantiles, take their variance from resamples of the items and of the batches of every partition instead; on the synthetic decisions, these standard deviations were about 40% too large. Fitted in sample, the model predicts the majority over M M batches within 0.9 points for every M M . Measured minus predicted, pooled over the ten pairs, is − - 0.2 [ − - 0.3, − - 0.1] points for this majority at M = 5 M=5 , − - 0.4 [ − - 0.5, − - 0.3] points for the flips between two majorities over three batches and +1.8 [+1.4, +2.2] points for the items whose fifteen decisions are not all equal; after Holm’s adjustment these differences are significant in two, five and four of the ten pairs. The calibrated column chooses the cut on ζ \zeta in every partition so that the batches give the single-item positive rate of the same items: it measures how much of the disagreement is a shift of the operating point, not what a recalibration estimated on other data would achieve.
blocks.zh: 主实验分出2分和12个新的统一随机分出,每分出2个080个平分;分出0个和1个平分(顺序为p0),单项投票运行,每分出15个独立分出分出,单项决定来自同类型的GPU,驱动和软件. 表18列出了15个分区中所有组MM的M随机批次占多数的物项的份额,与单一项目的决定不同;在9个至15个批次之间最多变化了0.7分。 统计数字仅使用有判决的项目,而且在所有15个分区(1 975-2 000个分区)。 它们之间的间隔是正常的,根据每件物品(去除一刀)的影响计算出一个相差,由所有15个分区的分批组合而成,不低于独立物品的相差;关于从阈值模型得出的合成决定,其效果在分批中共有,这种相差涵盖了95%至99%的模拟中的真实值。 校正统计,其被削减为等分数,取而代之的是重新标出物品和每个分区的批次的相差;在合成决定上,这些标准偏差大约为40%. 该模型在抽样中预测,每批MM在0.9分之内占多数。 经测算的负数预测,在10对以上的情况下,在M=5 M=5、0.4[--0.5、----0.3]这一多数情况下,在15个决定不完全相等的项目上,在三批以上两个多数之间的翻转点和+1.8[+1.4、+2.2]分之间,在Holm的调整后,这些差异在10对中的2个、5个和4个之间是显著的。 校正列在每个分区中选择 \\\ zeta 上的切入, 以便批次给出相同项目的单项正率 : 它测量分歧的多少是操作点的转变, 而不是其他数据估计的重新校正会达到什么效果 。
